'''Kimm Besh''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Kimm Besh system/Legends|Kimm Besh system]] of the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]], in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. It was one of a trio of dingy industrial worlds belonging to [[House Sreethyn]].<ref name="TEA" />
